about: Golden world hashes (compressed profile). First recorded before the parameter registry migration (stage C4); re-recorded for intended changes at C6 (territories, 29 Sep 2026), C6b (incursion geometry, 29 Sep 2026) and the C6 patrol corrections (docs/realism-design.md §5.3.1: per-chimp contact memory, single file, release, no heard boost or energy gate; 29 Sep 2026) and C10 (call signatures, caller discrimination, audience-dependent food calls; on by default; with the C10 switches off the old hashes reproduce, tests/sim-signals.test.ts; 29 Sep 2026), then C10 addendum 1 (travel hoos; off reproduces the C10 hashes). tests/fixtures/golden.ts computes them; world.sim.params is excluded.
